strategy: Spam Divine Lance as your primary damage source while using Advance and Rally for resource generation and mobility. Maintain Fanaticism and Defiance Auras passively, use Consecration for survivability, and attack in bursts to maximize Zealot synergy buffs through level 70.

paragon.note: Resplendence/Spirit and Exploit/Outmatch are interchangeable depending on path. Board Rush under Paragon 200, then move to the Step 1 setup. Maxroll shows this build's Paragon board pathing through an interactive planner (D4Planner) rather than as plain text, so the exact board order can't be faithfully scraped - check source_url for the visual layout.
